description: Header file defining the 'Process' class and nested 'Options' class for process management, including launching, killing, and I/O handling, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Class encapsulating process creation, management, and I/O operations with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Process::Options
classes.description: Nested class for configuring command-line options for process execution.

methods.name: Process::Options::Command
methods.description: Returns the command string to execute.

methods.name: Process::Options::Add
methods.description: Adds a parameter or a list of parameters to the options.

methods.name: Process::Options::LineSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the command line string.

methods.name: Process::Options::BlockSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the argument array for process launch.

methods.name: Process::Options::Line
methods.description: Constructs the command line string into a buffer.

methods.name: Process::Options::Block
methods.description: Constructs the argument array into a buffer.

methods.name: Process::Launch
methods.description: Starts the process with specified options, returns error code.

methods.name: Process::Kill
methods.description: Terminates the process, optionally with a hard kill.

methods.name: Process::WaitProcessCompleted
methods.description: Waits for process completion within a timeout.

methods.name: Process::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the process is still active.

methods.name: Process::HasConnector
methods.description: Checks if process has valid I/O handles.
